name: Intune Drive Mapping Generator
description: A web-based tool that generates PowerShell scripts for network drive mapping on Intune-managed Windows 10 devices. Converts existing Group Policy drive exports to Intune-compatible scripts, supports security group filtering with nested groups, and enables recurring execution.
author: Nicola Suter

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase shows two notable security concerns: (1) an XXE risk in XML parsing of user-provided data, and (2) a persistence mechanism in the generated PowerShell script that can be used for logon-time persistence with hidden execution. No credential theft, data exfiltration, or remote code execution patterns were observed in the analyzed code paths. Remediation should include securing XML parsing, and re-evaluating or documenting the endpoint-persistence approach in enterprise deployments.
